data: Thin, clearly visible wisps of steam rise gently from the open rim of a hot drink in a single pale ivory ceramic mug. The delicate translucent steam curls upward into the empty space above the mug, caught by soft morning sunlight from a window to the left and slightly behind it, visible against a darker softly blurred background. The steam remains light and airy, leaving the mug unobscured. Quiet, warm product photography: the unbranded off-white glazed mug rests on a natural wooden table, its entire rim, body, base and single handle clearly visible. Medium product shot from a three-quarter view at mug height: the whole mug including its handle occupies about half the image height, slightly right of center. Visible tabletop surrounds the base and handle, with ample space between every part of the mug and the frame edges, and generous headroom for the steam. Simple uncluttered background, shallow depth of field, realistic ceramic reflections and soft shadows, gentle warm light with the mug retaining its pale ivory color. A steady camera with a very slow subtle push-in, keeping the entire mug and handle comfortably inside the frame throughout.
